deadline.value: Apply by January 1; later applications may be considered if space permits, but may lose scholarships.
deadline.quote: Applications received after the Jan. 1 deadline for admission

app_fee.value: The application fee is $50, set by the University.

gre_general.value: The department no longer considers GRE scores for any applicant.
gre_general.quote: we no longer consider GRE scores

gre_subject.value: The department no longer considers GRE scores, so no subject test is used.
gre_subject.quote: we no longer consider GRE scores

toefl_min.value: The department FAQ sets a TOEFL iBT composite of at least 85.
toefl_min.quote: The TOEFL composite score should be at least 85.

ielts_min.value: The department FAQ sets an IELTS band of at least 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: The IELTS band score should be at least 6.5.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the committee, and students join a research group only after matriculating.
supervisor.quote: all students, whichever professor they eventually work for, must first apply to and be accepted into the program

also.quote: Individual professors do not make decisions regarding admissions

funding.value: Students in good standing get full tuition, health care and a stipend through TA, RA or fellowship awards.
funding.quote: Students in good standing are provided full tuition, health care benefits and stipend support for living expenses

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in chemistry or a related field is enough, but applicants with an Indian degree must also hold a master's (4-year Indian biotech degrees excepted).
entry_route.quote: A Master’s degree is not required, with one exception | applicants who have received their degree from an institution in India must have also completed a Master's degree

notes: The department FAQ sets TOEFL 85 and IELTS 6.5, below the Arts & Sciences table (TOEFL 94), so the department value is used; confirm with the department. The FAQ's fee-waiver link refers to a 2025 open house that has passed.
